Dansk Psykolog Forening is a Danish trade association for psychologists that appears in the corpus solely as a represented body on the steering group ("styregruppe") of the ADHD Database, a Danish health-quality database that monitors the diagnostic assessment and treatment of ADHD among children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2]. It is named in the list of steering group members in both the 2023 and 2024 editions of the ADHD Database documentation [^src1][^src2].

The ADHD Database's steering group draws on senior physicians, specialist doctors, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists and relatives' representatives from across Denmark's five regions, alongside professional societies, patient organisations, and the Danish Institute for Quality and Accreditation in Healthcare (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src1][^src2]. Dansk Psykolog Forening's inclusion reflects its role representing psychologists' professional interests within this multidisciplinary body overseeing data on ADHD assessment and treatment courses for children, young people, and — per the appendices covering April 2024 to March 2025 — also adults [^src2]. No further claims, relationships, or timeline events involving the organization are present in the corpus.
